title: tenant warming policy + hindsight quant calibrator for adaptive unit-econ
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: tenants with spiky but high-value traffic waste unit-econ when cold (cache misses) or when non-optimal quant tiers are chosen conservatively. This PR adds two cooperating components: (1) a tenant-adaptive warming policy that schedules short prefill requests and targeted KV cache warmups for tenants that cross a value threshold, and (2) a hindsight quant calibrator that processes recent request traces offline to suggest tenant-specific quantization tier assignments and safe rollback thresholds.

Goals: reduce tail per-token cost while keeping latency SLOs and avoiding perceptible quality regressions. Make recommendations auditable and reversible. Integrate into existing policy engine and Optimize telemetry.

What this PR changes: single continuous description string that includes the planned changes, diagrams referenced in docs, and migration notes. See changed_files for details.

Implementation highlights: - New tenant_warmer service (runtime component) that submits controlled prefill requests, tracks prefill success, and exposes metrics for cost/benefit per tenant. - HindsightQuantCalibrator (offline worker) that consumes recent traces, computes delta estimates for quality vs token-cost across quant tiers, and produces recommended quant tiers with confidence scores and rollback thresholds. - Policy glue in policy-engine to accept calibrator proposals and schedule canaries at percent-of-traffic with automatic rollback on quality drift. - Safe defaults and a global kill-switch to disable warming/calibrator per-organization. - New SDK endpoint for tenants to opt-out or pin quant tiers.

Backward compatibility & safety: default behavior is inert for tenants that do not opt in or do not meet the value threshold. All calibrator proposals are tagged with expected unit-econ delta and a confidence score; the rollout engine requires at least two high-confidence proposals and a successful canary before applying at scale.

Migration notes: Add a short migration step to the Private installer to enable the hindsight worker and grant it read access to recent trace buckets and cost telemetry. The terraform changes are optional and guarded by feature flags.

Related work: builds on ENG-7122 (batching-credit-meter) and ties into the prefilling primitives from ENG-6561. Supports SUP-3291 customer incident followups for tenant-specific cost spikes.

release_notes: Introduce tenant warming policy and hindsight quant calibrator. Adds tenant-level prefill to reduce cold-miss cost, and an offline calibrator that suggests tenant-specific quant tiers with safe canary rollouts. Feature disabled by default; opt-in via SDK or policy. Observability panels and runbooks included.
